name: @quifox/agent-plugin-mcp
description: Standard MCP tools mapped to ordinary Agent tools

scripts.build: bun run --filter @quifox/agent-core build && bun run --bun tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @quifox/agent-core build && bun run --bun tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit --pretty false
scripts.check: bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run test
